question: Who scored the most goals in premier league season?
text: **Erling Haaland** holds the record for most goals in a single Premier League season. He scored **36 goals in 35 appearances** for Manchester City in **2022/23**. ([premierleague.com](https://www.premierleague.com/en/stats/records?utm_source=openai))
